description: Secure, bounded, maximum-compression diagnostics download for offline analysis; one-time password display. Specification: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-09-encrypted-diagnostic-export-design.md

acceptance_criteria: One installation-wide export covers every retained project record without a project selector.
Archive includes Local AI Hub source, redacted effective configuration, Hub-owned operational databases, retained logs, and captured traces across projects.
Detailed request/response payloads are included only when capture was enabled and retained.
ZIP64 streaming uses AES-256 and BZIP2 level 9 with configurable 8 GiB archive and 64 GiB source defaults; cancellation/failure removes temporary files.
Fresh archive password is delivered after download and is never persisted; UI and docs warn about private operational content.
Model weights and unrelated project source are excluded.
Focused export tests pass and diff has no whitespace errors.
